clause: Enhance — native deterministic tier (demosaic/raw-details + integer super-resolution) [STU-RAW-014a]

scope.summary: Implement the native deterministic Enhance tier on the studio-engine path: demosaic / raw-details refinement (edge rendition, color rendering, artifact improvement at native resolution for Bayer/X-Trans sources) and integer/linear super-resolution upscale. Both MUST produce reproducible output under a fixed process version. This is the deterministic counterpart to the ML Enhance adapter (MT-428) and MUST NOT be conflated with it.
acceptance_criteria: native raw-details + integer super-resolution reproducible; distinct from ML tier
expected_tests: test: raw-details refinement + integer super-resolution reproducible under fixed process version
test: native tier distinct from ML adapter tier

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

target_entries: Studio / Camera Raw & Develop / Enhance — native

risk_if_missed: No deterministic Enhance; only ML path (reproducibility + adapter conflation).

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
